THE UNIT

A home base for people putting down roots.

Quiet, private, and looked after — one of six units set into a small hillside compound in Pecatu, with a shared pool, ocean views from the common areas, and a house manager on site.

Built for long-term expats, remote professionals, and couples who want their own front door without giving up a sense of community. Friendly, quiet, and settled — this is where people stay for a while.
